_comment: TEMPORARY — the election context for the two documents that exceed the Edge
Function's 2,000 ms CPU limit. NOT hand-written: produced by running the real
stockRecordLabel / stockIdentityHints / designOfRecordOrRow over the live
builder_stock_items rows, so the probe is handed exactly what production hands
the election and not an approximation of it.
This matters more than it looks. A first run of the probe passed a thinner
context — a plausible label, no design, no identity hints — and BOTH documents
answered not_identified in ~300 ms instead of recovered in ~1,200 ms. That is a
correct answer to the wrong question: with no estate name to corroborate by,
the cover rule cannot recognise a page, so nothing is decoded and the CPU-heavy
half never runs. It would have been recorded as a Cloudflare result.
